label: positive

blockers.detail: the harness makes exactly one json_tokener_parse_ex() call on a fresh tokener; the state-reconstruction block added by M only runs when json_tokener_state_number is resumed with a non-empty tok->pb from a previous call (every fresh entry into the number state resets pb), so it is unreachable

evidence: M changes the incremental (multi-call) contract of json_tokener_parse_ex: exponent state is no longer saved and is re-derived from the saved string on resume (tests/test_parse.c gains incremental test cases '0e+-', '12.3E12E12')
the OSS-Fuzz harness of that time (projects/json-c/tokener_parse_ex_fuzzer.cc, unchanged since 2018) parses the whole input in one call
rationale_zh: 本次提交修改 json_tokener_parse_ex() 的增量解析行为：数字的指数状态不再跨调用保存，而是在下一次调用恢复到 number 状态时，根据 tok->pb 中已保存的字符串重新推导（新增 printbuf_length(tok->pb) > 0 时的状态重建块）。这段代码只有在同一个 tokener 被多次调用、且上一次恰好停在数字中间时才会执行。OSS-Fuzz harness 对每个输入只在新建的 tokener 上调用一次 parse_ex，每次新进入 number 状态都会先 printbuf_reset，因此这段跨调用状态重建逻辑覆盖恒为 0，harness 照常运行。属于本次引入的隐式 state 退化（解析器跨调用的状态恢复契约从未被测试）；反事实修复 Δh 用首字节作为切分点，把其余输入分两次喂给同一 tokener。
rationale_en: This commit changes the incremental behaviour of json_tokener_parse_ex(): the exponent state of a number is no longer saved across calls but re-derived, when a later call resumes in the number state, from the string already saved in tok->pb (the new state-reconstruction block guarded by printbuf_length(tok->pb) > 0). That code runs only when the same tokener is called repeatedly and the previous call stopped in the middle of a number. The OSS-Fuzz harness calls parse_ex once per input on a fresh tokener, and every fresh entry into the number state resets the print buffer, so the cross-call state reconstruction keeps zero coverage while the harness runs normally. Introduced silent state degradation (the parser's cross-call resume contract is never exercised); the counterfactual fix Δh uses the first byte as a split point and feeds the rest of the input to the same tokener in two chunks.
